script_text: Stop everything, Taurus—the cosmic order is unraveling your routine! Venus, your earthy ruler, is conjunct Uranus in your 5th House of Creativity, igniting sudden changes and rebellious energy. This disruptive aspect squares Saturn in your 8th House of Shared Resources, cautioning against impulsive financial decisions. In love, if single, Venus-Uranus attracts unconventional, exciting partners through artistic venues. If taken, discuss money matters openly to avoid tension. Career-wise, Mercury in your 10th House trines Pluto, boosting your influence—seize leadership opportunities. Financially, Mars in your 2nd House warns against overspending. A blessing arrives in the form of intuitive insights guiding you to stability. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
